name: The Realm of Eldoria
Reveals: The entire known world, major cities, and trade routes
Location Found: Given to all new adventurers at the starting town
Description: A large, weathered parchment depicting the continent of Eldoria with ink-stained borders and hand-drawn mountains.

name: The Northern Wastes
Reveals: The frozen tundra north of the Ironspine Mountains
Location Found: Purchased from the Cartographer's Guild in Frosthold
Description: A冰-stiffened map with blue-tinted ink, showing ice formations and blizzard paths across the northern reaches.

name: The Shattered Isles
Reveals: The scattered archipelago east of the mainland
Location Found: Dropped by the Kraken Priestess in the Abyssal Depths
Description: A waterlogged map drawn on treated sharkskin, with islands marked by cryptic symbols in an unknown script.

name: The Ember Expanse
Reveals: The volcanic desert region south of the Ashlands
Location Found: Found in the scorched remains of Pyrethorn Village
Description: A heat-warped parchment with edges singed black, depicting lava flows and obsidian formations in red ink.

name: The Verdant Depths
Reveals: The layered canopy cities of the Great Elderwood
Location Found: Gifted by the Elf Queen in Sylvandor
Description: A living map that grows moss along its edges, showing the forest in shifting shades of green that change with the light.

name: The Abyssal Trenches
Reveals: The underwater cave networks beneath the Ocean of Sorrows
Location Found: Recovered from the Sunken Temple of Nethys
Description: A bioluminescent map that glows faintly in darkness, with depth markings in phosphorescent ink.

name: The Shadowlands
Reveals: The cursed territories where the veil between worlds is thin
Location Found: Stolen from the Lich King's archives in Dreadmoor
Description: A map that appears blank until held under moonlight, revealing twisted paths through perpetual twilight.

name: The Sky Reach Territories
Reveals: The floating islands above the Cloudspire Mountains
Location Found: Purchased from the Aeronaut's Guild in Windhaven
Description: A lightweight parchment that seems to flutter even in still air, with islands drawn as if viewed from above.

name: The Crystal Wastes
Reveals: The crystalline desert where magic behaves unpredictably
Location Found: Encased in a massive crystal formation near Prisma Gate
Description: A translucent map etched onto a thin sheet of pure crystal, refracting light into prismatic patterns.

name: The Underdark
Reveals: The vast network of tunnels and caverns beneath the surface world
Location Found: Commissioned from the Dwarven King in Ironforge Deep
Description: A map carved from living stone that pulses faintly with geothermal energy, showing passages that shift over time.

name: Goblin Cave Network
Reveals: The tunnel layout of the Goblin Warrens beneath Thorn Ridge
Location Found: Looted from Goblin King Griznak
Description: A crude map scratched onto rough animal hide, with tunnels marked by goblin pictograms.

name: The Sunken Catacombs
Reveals: The flooded burial chambers beneath the old capital
Location Found: Found on the corpse of a drowned explorer
Description: A water-stained map sealed in an enchanted oilskin pouch, with depth markers in faded blue ink.

name: The Frozen Labyrinth
Reveals: The ever-shifting ice maze within the Glacier of Lost Souls
Location Found: Carved into an ice tablet by a dying frost mage
Description: A crystalline map etched into thin ice, with paths that rearrange themselves when the temperature changes.

name: The Obsidian Halls
Reveals: The volcanic fortress carved into Mount Pyreclaw
Location Found: Hidden in a fireproof chest in the Ember Guard's quarters
Description: A heat-resistant map drawn on treated dragon scale, with lava flows marked in molten gold ink.

name: The Whispering Crypts
Reveals: The haunted burial chambers beneath Shadowmere
Location Found: Given by the ghost of the last crypt keeper
Description: A translucent map that whispers the names of the dead when unfolded, with rooms marked by ghostly symbols.

name: The Crystal Caverns
Reveals: The gem-filled caves beneath the Diamond Peaks
Location Found: Discovered by mining accident in the Deepdelve mines
Description: A map that sparkles with embedded gem dust, showing crystal formations as colorful geometric patterns.

name: The Serpent's Coil
Reveals: The twisting tunnels of the Yuan-ti temple complex
Location Found: Stolen from a Yuan-ti priestess during a diplomatic theft
Description: A sinuous map drawn on shed snake skin, with paths that coil and spiral in hypnotic patterns.

name: The Clockwork Depths
Reveals: The mechanical labyrinth beneath the Artificer's tower
Location Found: Assembled from components found across the Gearworks district
Description: A precise technical drawing on brass-plated parchment, with moving parts that shift to show different configurations.

name: The Abyssal Rift
Reveals: The dimensional tear leading to the Far Realms
Location Found: Manifested spontaneously when the Rift Seal was broken
Description: A map that appears to fold into impossible geometries, with spaces that exist in more dimensions than three.

name: The Dragon's Maw
Reveals: The volcanic nest complex of the Elder Dragon Ignarith
Location Found: Recovered from the hoard of the slain dragon Vaelthor
Description: A map that radiates intense heat, drawn on ancient dragon scale with ink made from dragon blood.

name: The Goblin Warrens Expansion
Reveals: Additional tunnels in the goblin network beyond the initial caves
Location Found: Looted from a goblin shaman
Description: A rough map showing newer tunnels, marked with crude drawings of traps and treasure.

name: The Sunken Temple
Reveals: The submerged temple of an ancient water deity
Location Found: Retrieved from a shipwreck in the Bay of Whispers
Description: A waterproof map on treated kelp paper, with water currents marked by flowing blue lines.

name: The Frostfang Bore
Reveals: The deep ice mines where frost giants harvest eternal ice
Location Found: Carved into a block of perpetual ice
Description: A map that stays perpetually cold, with tunnels marked in frost patterns on silvered glass.

name: The Shadow Vault
Reveals: The extradimensional treasury hidden within the Shadowfell
Location Found: Created by a shadow sorcerer as part of a binding contract
Description: A map that exists partially in shadow, visible only when cast in darkness, with rooms that overlap with the real world.

name: The Dragon Graveyard
Reveals: The ancient burial grounds where dragonkind laid their dead
Location Found: Inscribed on the wall of the First Dragon's tomb
Description: A map that radiates primal magic, drawn with dragonfire on the hide of a primordial wyrm.

name: Pirate's Lost Hoard
Reveals: The buried treasure of Captain Blacktide on Dead Man's Island
Location Found: Hidden in a bottle washed ashore at Saltmere Beach
Description: A salt-stained map with a skull and crossbones, marked with an X over a lone palm tree.

name: Dragon's First Hoard
Reveals: The initial treasure hoard of the young dragon Scorchscale
Location Found: Singed and left behind when Scorchscale fled a greater predator
Description: A scorched map with claw marks, showing a cave entrance hidden behind a waterfall of molten rock.

name: The Dwarven Vault
Reveals: The ancestral vault of Clan Ironforge containing centuries of accumulated wealth
Location Found: Inherited from a dying dwarven noble
Description: A precise map engraved on a metal plate, with combination locks and security mechanisms noted in dwarven runes.

name: The Sunken Galleon
Reveals: The wreck of the Golden Maiden carrying spices and silks
Location Found: Purchased from a retired pirate in the Rusty Anchor tavern
Description: A waterproof map with depth markings and sea creature warnings, drawn on sharkskin.

name: The Bandit King's Stash
Reveals: Hidden caches of stolen goods throughout the Greenway
Location Found: Found in the bandit camp after clearing the Greenway
Description: A simple map with multiple X marks, drawn hastily on torn paper with a burnt stick.

name: The Elven Starweave
Reveals: The vault of preserved Starweave artifacts from the Second Age
Location Found: Hidden within an enchanted music box in the Elven Archive
Description: A luminous map that projects a 3D hologram of the vault when held under starlight.

name: The Gnomish Contraption
Reveals: A hidden workshop filled with working gnomish inventions
Location Found: Assembled from scattered blueprints found in a collapsing tower
Description: A mechanical map with moving parts, requiring the user to solve a puzzle to reveal the full location.

name: The Vampire's Reliquary
Reveals: The hidden vault containing the vampire lord's most prized possessions
Location Found: Stolen from the vampire's castle during a daylight raid
Description: A map drawn in blood that fades in sunlight, only visible in darkness or candlelight.

name: The Titan's Forgotten Treasury
Reveals: The lost treasury of the Titan civilization buried beneath the mountains
Location Found: pieced together from fragments scattered across multiple ancient sites
Description: A massive map that can only be read when all fragments are assembled, with gold leaf accents and titan script.

name: The Smuggler's Run
Reveals: The hidden coves and tunnels used by the Smuggler's Guild
Location Found: Found on a captured smuggler in the Docks District
Description: A coded map with a key in the margin, showing coastal caves and underwater passages.

name: The Feywild Cache
Reveals: A pocket dimension containing preserved feywild treasures
Location Found: Given as payment by a grateful fey spirit
Description: A map that shimmers between colors, with locations that only appear during specific phases of the moon.

name: The Lich's Phylactery
Reveals: The hidden location of the Lich King's phylactery
Description: A cursed map that drains life force from whoever reads it, with directions that change to confuse seekers
Location Found: Extracted from the Lich's lieutenant through interrogation

name: The Merchant Prince's Legacy
Reveals: The hidden vault of the Merchant Prince containing rare trade goods
Location Found: Bequeathed in the will of a dying merchant
Description: A detailed map on fine parchment with gold ink annotations and a seal of the Merchant Prince's guild.

name: The Elemental Nexus
Reveals: The convergence point where elemental energies crystallize into pure magic
Location Found: Manifested during a magical experiment gone wrong
Description: A map that shifts between elemental themes—fire, water, earth, air—depending on who holds it.

name: The Necropolis Hoard
Reveals: The central tomb of the Necropolis containing the Crown of Undying Kings
Location Found: Discovered through a prophecy from the Oracle of Bones
Description: A bone-white map that whispers promises of power, with a route marked in ghostly green flames.

name: The Lost City of Aetheron
Reveals: The hidden entrance to the flying city that fell from the sky
Location Found: Hidden within an ancient tome in the Grand Library
Description: A map that floats slightly above any surface, showing both the ruins on the ground and traces of where the city once hovered.

name: The Hidden Temple of Solara
Reveals: The secret sun temple hidden within the desert ruins
Location Found: Given by a dying desert pilgrim
Description: A sun-bleached map with golden markings that only become visible in direct sunlight.

name: The Oracle's Path
Reveals: The pilgrimage route to the Oracle of the Eternal Spring
Location Found: Received after completing the Trial of Faith
Description: A map that updates in real-time to show the safest path through dangerous territory.

name: The Dragon Prophecy
Reveals: The locations where ancient dragon artifacts must be united
Location Found: Decoded from a prophecy carved in the Dragon King's tomb
Description: A prophetic map that shows different locations depending on who reads it, always guiding toward the reader's destiny.

name: The Sealed Gate
Reveals: The location and mechanisms to open the ancient sealed gate
Location Found: Found in the ruins of the gate's original guardians
Description: A technical diagram showing complex locking mechanisms and the sequence to unlock them.

name: The Blood Moon Ritual
Reveals: The sites where the cult performs their blood moon rituals
Location Found: Confiscated from a captured cultist
Description: A disturbing map written in what appears to be blood, showing ritual circles and sacrifice locations.

name: The Elemental Convergence
Reveals: The four elemental temples that must be balanced
Location Found: Assembled from fragments found in each temple
Description: A four-part map that fits together like a puzzle, with each section resonating with a different element.

name: The King's Lost Crown
Reveals: The burial site of the First King and his legendary crown
Location Found: Commissioned by the current king from the Royal Historian
Description: A regal map on royal parchment with the seal of the current monarchy, showing both ancient and modern landmarks.

name: The World Tree Roots
Reveals: The root system of Yggdrasil connecting the Nine Realms
Location Found: Carved into the bark of the World Tree by an ancient seer
Description: A living map that pulses with the heartbeat of the world, showing root paths that glow with realm energy.

name: The Void Rift
Reveals: The exact location of the rift threatening to consume the world
Location Found: Received from the dying words of the Void Walker
Description: A map that hurts to look at, with locations that exist in both reality and the void simultaneously.

name: The Plague's Source
Reveals: The origin point of the magical plague afflicting the kingdom
Location Found: Compiled from witness testimonies and symptom tracking
Description: A map marked with infection spread patterns, with the source circled in quarantine red.

name: The Time Anomaly
Reveals: Points in time-space where temporal distortions occur
Location Found: Created by the Chronomancer after studying the anomalies
Description: A map that appears to show the same location at multiple points in time, overlapping like translucent layers.

name: The Artifact Hunt
Reveals: The scattered locations of the Shattered Star artifact pieces
Location Found: Given by the artifact hunters' guild
Description: A map with glowing points that intensify when the holder is near an artifact piece.

name: The Summoning Circle
Reveals: The components and location needed to summon the Ancient One
Location Found: Hidden within the forbidden section of the Arcane Academy
Description: A dangerous map that radiates chaotic energy, with geometric patterns that seem to shift when viewed directly.

name: The Spirit's Redemption
Reveals: The restless spirits that need to be laid to rest
Location Found: Given by the spirits themselves during a séance
Description: A ghostly map that only appears when held by someone with spiritual sensitivity, showing ghostly auras around restless souls.

name: The Cartographer's Masterwork
Reveals: All previously discovered locations in perfect detail
Location Found: Completed after finding all other maps in the world
Description: The ultimate map, a living document that updates in real-time with every location the holder has ever visited, rendered in exquisite detail.

name: The Mimic Map
Reveals: Nothing useful—it's actually a mimic pretending to be a map
Location Found: Purchased from a suspicious traveling merchant
Description: An unusually thick map that seems to breathe slightly, with edges that feel oddly... fleshy.

name: The Reverse Map
Reveals: Every location EXCEPT where you actually want to go
Location Found: Found in the Inverted Tower of Mages
Description: A map that shows everything backwards, left becomes right and north becomes south, with text written in mirror script.

name: The Blank Map
Reveals: Nothing until you discover a location, then it reveals that location
Location Found: Sold by any general store
Description: A completely blank piece of fine parchment, waiting to be filled with discoveries.

name: The Treasure Map That Leads to Another Map
Reveals: The location of yet another treasure map
Location Found: Dug up from a suspicious patch of dirt
Description: A treasure map with a large X that, when followed, leads to another treasure map buried nearby.

name: The Animated Map
Reveals: Real-time movement of creatures and people in a specific region
Location Found: Created by an archmage with divination abilities
Description: A map with tiny animated figures that move in real-time, showing the positions of everyone in the tracked region.

name: The Dimensional Key
Reveals: Portals between dimensions that no other map can show
Location Found: Assembled from pieces scattered across multiple planes of existence
Description: A map that exists on multiple planes simultaneously, showing connections between realities as shimmering threads.

name: The Memory Map
Reveals: The holder's most important memories as locations
Location Found: Created by a psychic healer from the holder's own memories
Description: A deeply personal map that shows abstract representations of memories as places, unique to each person who views it.

name: The Cursed Map
Reveals: True treasure, but at a terrible cost
Location Found: Found in the chest of a dead adventurer who looked... happy
Description: A beautiful map with golden ink that seems to whisper promises of riches, with a warning written in blood at the bottom.

name: The Map of Fate
Reveals: The path to the holder's destiny
Location Found: Bestowed by the Fates themselves at the crossroads of destiny
Description: A luminous map that shows different paths depending on the choices the holder has made, always pointing toward their ultimate fate.
